issues.explanation: New action, enum and exception ship with no Pest/PHPUnit test, violating the TDD rule that every feature ships with a test.

Fairness restriction and normal-waiting existence check are computed once, so a concurrent race that removes the last normal leaves the loop restricted to normals and throws instead of falling back to priority.
Public invokable action has no PHPDoc, although conventions require PHPDoc on touched public methods.
Mode re-check mixes strict priority === 0 with priority > 0 without an int cast, fragile if the attribute is not integer-cast.

conventions.evidence: app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:20 uses app/Actions/* for domain write; docs/architecture.md:189 and docs/business-rules.md:223 keep docs in sync; but no test file violates TDD and app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:22 has no PHPDoc

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/* or test edits; no coverage for ordering, fairness, modes, inactive queue, or exactly-once paths

review.summary: Implements CallNextTicket with correct queue locking, deterministic ordering, fairness, exactly-once skip, contract types and doc updates. The implementation is lean and in scope, but it ships with no tests as required by TDD, blocking merge until a test suite is added.
